title: Driven on the keg: at new's argument order, the intent@2 remedy no tap has, and a pre-v2.10 project told there is no project
body:
From dc's keg drives:

- `at new` fails in the argument order its usage prints, because the `--covers` variadic swallows the ids.
- A project stamped below v2.19.0 is told to `install intent@2`, which no tap has.
- A pre-v2.10 project (a top-level `.intent/`) is told "no Intent project found" (`project.rs:866`).

Line numbers as at the audit.

Found by hv's estate-wide doc audit of 2026-09-11 (the audit's orders are in `intent/history/20260911-doc-audit.md`), where it is described as built. Carried in `intent/wip.md` as an unruled defect until 2026-09-13, when that file was leaned and every open defect became an issue. Not worked until hv rules it; a ruled one gets a lane.
